Counts: Seeking Alpha 3 (profile says 7; 4 not retrievable), Investing.com 5 (complete per contributor page 205818057), DataDrivenInvestor 34 (Medium publication; the brief asked for it), U.Today 1 interview, Payment Week 1, PR Newswire 2, Bitcoin News Asia 1, CryptoNinjas 1, Substack 2. Total 50. Views: none of these sites expose view counts publicly (Seeking Alpha, Investing.com, U.Today, Payment Week checked incl. a 2021 Wayback copy of an Investing.com page); Medium only shows claps, recorded in notes where captured. Blocked / unreadable: Seeking Alpha instablog list page and JSON API (captcha, 404); DuckDuckGo, Mojeek, Startpage, Yandex, Google (captcha/consent/403); Bing returned zero hits for the name; medium.com HTML and medium.com/search (403 Cloudflare; RSS feeds and Wayback snapshots worked); datadriveninvestor.com site search (403) and author pages (404); LinkedIn (HTTP 999) so LinkedIn Pulse articles could not be checked; Tech in Asia and web.archive.org are not fetchable by WebFetch (Wayback was used via curl, rate-limited 429/504 at times); paymentweek.com down (525); listennotes/podchaser (403); Carbon Pulse (403/paywall) for 'Carbon traders Virtuse move EU desk to Singapore' (2018-03, not confirmed to quote him); X/Twitter not searched (no access).
